system_prompt_style.note: Prompt conditions on observation, feasible actions, short-term memory and experience rules; ablation removes 'the corresponding section in the main prompt' (Sec. 5.4). No prompt code available.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: providing the screenshot alongside the actionable ele- ments of the current webpage to support the choice of next action.
env_context_strategy.note: Content Extractor injects page content and feasible actions each step; the agent also navigates the web app by acting. Closest fit; the env is a web page, not a repo.

context_compaction.note: Memory window k defined (Sec. 3.1) and ablations restrict it, but the default compaction mechanism is not specified; no code available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: otxt t contains textual DOM information,oimg t is a webpage screenshot, andoelm t denotes the set of interactable elements.
observation_format.note: Screenshot used only when duplicate actions arise (Alg. 1 lines 21-22).

tool_call_format.note: Actions are (op, element, value) tuples; output syntax/parser not described.

tool_count.note: No tool list; actions are web operations (click, input) over DOM elements.

edit_primitive.note: No file editing described; web-testing agent. No tool registry available.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; no dependency list to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Inspired by ReAct (Yao et al., 2023), which enables LLMs to interleave rea- soning and acting
loop_primitives.note: Per-step state evaluator G decides success/stop before each action (Alg. 1).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: HxAgent per- forms proactive correction which reassesses and adjusts its plan after each step

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: We introduce HxAgent, an iterative LLM-based planning agent with a proactive correction strat- egy.
multi_agent_topology.note: Several LLM components (Content Extractor, State Evaluator, Action Grounding, Rule Extractor) in one loop.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: HxAgent operates with two key components: 1) Iterative LLM- based Agent Planning to produce action sequences, and 2) Experience Reinforcement
delegation_mechanism.note: Architecture description lists no delegation; paper-only.

human_in_loop.note: Only mentions outcome updated 'when human judgment is not involved'; no gating mechanism described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: HxAgent maintains a structured memory of prior interactions
short_term_state.note: Sequence action memory of (state, action) pairs.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Rules are stored as plain-text heuristics alongside their source SoA.
long_term_memory.note: Experience memory stores trajectories with success labels plus extracted rules; storage medium unspecified.

self_verification.evidence_quote: State Eval- uator 2 implements the evaluation functionG by employing the LLM to evaluate the current state
self_verification.note: Same LLM (GPT-4o) evaluates state; could be read as llm_judge.

retry_policy.note: Training phase runs multiple tries per task; evaluation retry policy not stated.

termination_condition.note: Evaluator G returns success or early stop on divergence (Alg. 1 lines 7-19); stall_detection = LLM early termination, closest fit.

cost_controls.note: Token cost measured (Sec. 5.5), no controls described.

execution_isolation.note: Actions run in a Selenium/ChromeDriver browser; isolation boundary not stated.

network_policy.note: Accesses live websites, but no network config surface available.

permission_model.note: Actions restricted to feasible set A(ot), a grounding constraint rather than authorisation.

replayability.evidence_quote: The test cases can be automatically replayed in the target environment during regression testing.
replayability.note: Generated scripts replay without LLM; environment may differ (90.8% valid on real-world).

target_domain.evidence_quote: HxAgent: Iterative Agent Planning for End-to-End Web Application Testing

open_source.note: 'Data/code are available on our website' but no licence given.

model_agnostic.note: Only GPT-4o used; no client abstraction described.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Data/code are available on our website (HxAgent).

first_release_date.note: Fallback to paper v1 date; no tags available.
